now.title: Logan

now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 11, in the year 3960, Apocalypse's Final Horsemen fall on the time-lost X-Men, until Morph turns the fight as Thor.

proposed.text: In episode 11, in the year 3960, Apocalypse's Horsemen fall on the time-lost X-Men, until Morph turns the fight as Thor.

changes.evidence: X-Men '97 episode 11 (Days of Past Future): the 3960 A.D. group is Apocalypse's Horsemen (Death, Famine, Pestilence, War). 'Final Horsemen' is the comics label from Uncanny X-Force that the Marvel Database notes these four are based on; neither the episode summary nor the episode's own wiki entry uses it, so it is a name the screen does not use.

owner_calls.question: The file's name is 'The Final Horsemen', a comics label (Uncanny X-Force). On screen in X-Men '97 episode 11 they appear as Apocalypse's Horsemen. Rename the file?
owner_calls.evidence: The Marvel Database lists the 3960 A.D. team as 'Horsemen of Apocalypse' and notes they are only based on the comics' Final Horsemen.
